hypothesis: Opponent-adjusted historical serve and return point strengths add winner-prediction information beyond Elo/rank and beyond unadjusted serve/return strengths.
data: Same frozen raw Sackmann 2020-2025 and accepted score corpus as EXP07/08; raw source-key/IDs/date verification, no ordinal/history joins. Raw response ids inherited from protocol.json. No 2026 or live holdout reads.
past_work: EXP20261027-07/08 game/rank, EXP20261026-04 fresh WTA hold replacement, existing fit_hold_ml regression. This tests online opponent-adjusted service POINT abilities as independent match-winner inputs, not another hold refresh or nudge deletion.
availability: Strict tournament_start+21d < forecast_date for updates and fit labels. Synthetic conservative reconstruction; historical publication/observation clocks remain FLAG.
point_validation: Each side svpt,1stIn,1stWon,2ndWon must be integer counts: svpt>0, 0<=1stWon<=1stIn<=svpt, 0<=2ndWon<=svpt-1stIn. BOTH sides valid or skip point update. No imputation from winner labels, current-match points never enter own forecast. Predict same baseline-covered population, missing histories give zero features.
point_model: Logit P(server wins point)=mu_tour+S_server-R_returner. Mu fit ONLY accepted 2020 matches whose +21d availability precedes 2021-01-01; no later refit. Separate overall/surface state, surface starts from pre-update overall; forecast mix .35 overall+.65 surface. All dyad residuals computed BEFORE any match update. Learning rate=120*ln(10)/400/(prior_valid_point_matches+5)^0.4; fractions per match, not count-weighted. One frozen curve, no search.
unadjusted_ablation: S updated against sigmoid(mu+S) ignoring opponent R; R updated against sigmoid(mu-R) ignoring opponent S. Same valid input rows, schedule, learning rate and surface mix as adjusted arm.
fit: Same no-intercept ridge=1 logistic, no scaler or hyperparameter search. Warmup 2020; fit expanding from2021 using only available labels. Same five dev folds 2023H1/H2,2024H1/H2,2025H1. Primary candidate ONLY adjusted; single-S/R arms are attribution controls, cannot be chosen after seeing results.
decision: Advance adjusted research only if BOTH LL and Brier improve vs rank AND raw in ALL five dev folds, and removal of either S/R worsens aggregate dev losses. Otherwise reject combined, no posthoc choice of raw/single component. Confirmation2025H2 opened only on dev-pass, then paired CI vs rank and raw must exclude zero for BOTH metrics; ATP/WTA both nonworsening. 2025 already seen repeatedly, NEVER a fresh holdout. No production promotion while PIT FLAG or market guard fails.
market_diagnostic: Apply frozen pre-existing 2023/24 paired B365 join and EV>0/1u rule from EXP08, no thresholds/book/window changes. Run primary adjusted and raw attribution on identical matched fixtures even if dev fails, labelled descriptive/rejected; no confirmation rescue. Historical quote clocks unverified, not executable ROI/CLV. Report loss, calibration bins, hypothetical profit, coverage and tour/surface/level/odds cohorts. No market price input to model.
stop: No added variants, window changes, parameter rescue or winner-conditioned orientation. Ruler unchanged; all model code remains offline research. Save rejected model code only to non-main branch per repo closeout instruction.
